effects.text: Each target swears an oath of no more than twenty-five words; for the duration each knows if another knowingly violates it. Nothing is compelled, located or punished.

system.description:
LINGUISTIC SOUL UTILITY
Tradition divinity
Cast 1 minute (somatic, verbal)
Range 10 feet
Targets 2 willing creatures
Duration 1 day

You magically witness a promise willingly exchanged between the targets.
Each target states an oath of no more than twenty-five words. For the duration, each target immediately knows if another target knowingly and deliberately violates the stated oath.
The spell does not compel anybody to obey the oath, determine whether a creature intends to break it, reveal where or how the oath was broken, or punish a creature for violating it.
An ambiguous oath remains ambiguous. The spell recognises the words sworn rather than what one participant privately hoped they meant.

Warping Options:
+1 PP: Add one willing participant.
+2 PP: Increase the duration to 1 week.
+4 PP: Increase the duration to 1 month.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10.
